description:
Best Mid Drive Electric Bike Deal: Compare to eBikes from Trek or Specialized. The Elite eUrban focuses on practical city/hybrid comfort with Shimano STEPS E5000 mid-drive assist, integrated 500WH smart battery, Shimano hydraulic disc brakes, air lockout suspension fork, rack, fenders and kickstand.

Best Spec For The Money: Similar top rated eBikes with these high-grade specs can cost $3,000 and up.

If you see a bike priced similar to Bikesdirect.com special sale pricing, make sure you are comparing apples to apples: • AIR SunTour LockOut Suspension Fork • FULL SHIMANO Drivetrain • SHIMANO STEPS MID DRIVE MOTOR •~90+ MILE RANGE • 500WH Smart Integrated Battery • SHIMANO Hydraulic Disc Brakes • FREE Rear Rack, Front/Rear Fenders and eBike Rated Kickstand

Lower cost eBikes are often heavier, shorter-range hub-drive models with lower-quality non-Shimano or house-brand components, often without Hydraulic Disc Brakes or AIR Suspension Forks.
